scenarios.title: Two intruders enter through forced stockroom window
scenarios.hypothesis_summary: two people arrive in a light-coloured van in the service lane. One forces and climbs through the stockroom west window while the other waits at the sill, then the insider goes to the office safe and the racking, hands boxes out through the window for loading into the van, climbs back out, and both leave in the van.

supporting_facts.text: CCTV records two people in dark clothing getting out of a light-coloured van and walking to the stockroom window, one carrying a long object.
The stockroom window frame was prised open, a pry bar was left under it, and the alarm recorded glass break or shock then stockroom motion.
person with the tool climbed in feet first while the other stayed outside, boxes were handed through the window and carried to the van, and the insider later climbed back out.
Office motion and safe-door opening were recorded, the safe was found open and empty, and boxed drills were reported taken from the racking.
Two different sets of footwear marks were found inside, supporting two intruders rather than one.

contradicted_points.text: The night cleaner reported hearing a van and two doors at about 01:10, whereas CCTV places the van arrival at about 01:39; the camera clock offset was not recorded, so the timing discrepancy is unsettled.
The identities and faces of the two intruders were not seen or established, and no van number plate was recorded.
K02 was used to unlock the customer door at 23:48 and lock it at 00:03 before the window entry; who used it then is not established and is not attributed to any named person here.
